title: unified-rollouts: staged shadow + weighted canary with proactive auto-rollback
author: Ava Thompson
description:
Motivation: Improve rollout safety and flexibility by combining staged shadow probing with a weighted canary path and proactive multi-metric auto-rollback. This change addresses flaky rollouts observed during high-load experiments where a single metric threshold triggered noisy rollbacks or missed regressions when shadow traffic was insufficient.

Summary: Adds a staged shadow probing controller, weighted canary actor, multi-metric aggregator, and a new proactive auto-rollback policy that considers latency, token-error-rate, and semantic-quality (via evaluation hooks). The new flow allows: staged increasing shadow probe volume before diverting live traffic, fractional weighted canaries that ramp using configured schedules, and rollback decisions based on a configurable aggregation of metrics with cooldowns and safety-guards.

Key design points: 1) Staged Shadow Controller: probes new model variants with increasing percentage of shadow traffic in stages (1%, 5%, 15%, 30%) while collecting full telemetry. Each stage has a minimum sample-size guard to avoid noisy stats. 2) Weighted Canary Actor: supports fractional traffic weights (0.1% -> 50%) with time-based ramps and immediate manual overrides. 3) Multi-Metric Aggregator: configurable set of metrics (p50 latency, p95 latency, token-error-rate, model-fallback-rate, semantic-regression-score) with user-defined thresholds and weights. Aggregation yields a single rollback_score which drives auto-rollback actions. 4) Proactive Auto-Rollback Policy: evaluates rollback_score each evaluation window, honors cooldowns and progressive backoff, supports immediate revert when score exceeds critical thresholds. 5) Safety guards: min-healthy constraint, no-rollback-during-db-migrations flag, and canary-fallback routing to a stable variant on detected regressions.

What changed (high-level files): - rollout/controller/staged_shadow_controller.go: new controller and state machine for staged probing - rollout/actors/weighted_canary.go: traffic-weighting and ramp scheduler - rollout/policies/multi_metric_aggregator.go: aggregator + threshold config - rollout/policies/proactive_autorollback.go: policy implementation + tests - api/v1/rollout_types.proto: new fields for staged_shadow, weight_schedule, and autorollback_policy - console/ui/rollout_edit.tsx: UI controls for staged shadow and weighting - observability/dashboards/rollouts_overview.json: new panels for rollback_score and stage-sample-size - integration tests: integration/rollouts/staged_shadow_e2e_test.go - e2e load test harness update: perf/canary_load_generator.py

Testing: - Unit tests cover state transitions, aggregator math, and scheduling logic (coverage: 88% on modified packages). - Integration tests simulate shadow probe stages and validate sample-size gating and metric aggregation. - Load tests run weighted canary at 30% traffic for 60m across a synthetic workload; observed overhead < 2% tail latency under 90th percentile compared to baseline. - Canary rollback simulation injected regression (increased token-error-rate + semantic drop) and verified auto-rollback triggered within 2 evaluation windows, and fallback routing completed within 120s.

Backward compatibility & migration: - API additions are additive; existing rollout configs continue to work. - New proto fields default to safe values (no staged shadow, legacy single-metric rollback behavior). - We add a migration job that backfills default weight_schedules for existing canary rollouts if customers opt-in; this migration is documented in upgrade notes.

Observability & Ops: - New rollout-level metric "rollout.rollback_score" emitted with tags: rollout_id, stage, model_variant, region. - Alerting runbook added: when rollback_score > critical for >2 windows, page on-call SRE and automatically pause cross-region promotion. - Console shows staged sample sizes, aggregated metrics, and an Explain panel with contributing metrics for any rollback decision.

Security & safety: - No new sensitive data paths. All telemetry uses existing sanitized traces and aggregated histograms. Role checks added to enable manual override in console (requires rollout:edit permission).

Rollout plan: - Merge to main behind feature flag rollout.unified_staged_shadow. Gradual opt-in to beta customers. Monitor rollback_score and rollout-slo regressions for 2 weeks before enabling by default.

Related: ENG-1127 (staged shadow rollout), ENG-1189 (multi-metric autorollback), SUP-8421 (customer incident prompting proactive rollback).

Weighted canary actor and ramp scheduler (weighted_canary.go)
API proto updates and console wiring (rollout_types.proto, rollout_edit.tsx)
review_comments: Diego Martinez (reviewer): The staged shadow controller looks good overall. Two requests: (1) add a minimum sample-size unit test for when traffic is extremely low, and (2) ensure the aggregator weights are configurable via API (not hardcoded).
Ava Thompson (author): Thanks Diego — added tests (tests/unit/multi_metric_aggregator_test.go) and made aggregator weights a proto field with defaults. See commit 3/6.
Priya Nair (reviewer): We need to ensure this won't cause unexpected DB load when running large shadow samples. Please include a guard to limit concurrent shadow probes per region.
Ava Thompson (author): Added concurrency guard in staged_shadow_controller.go and unit tests that simulate region limits. Also added a doc note in docs/ops/rollouts_autorollback.md.
Ben Collins (reviewer): Observability looks great. Please add an example alert threshold and runbook link in the dashboard JSON.
Ava Thompson (author): Added alert reference and runbook URL to observability/dashboards/rollouts_overview.json and observability/alerts/rollout_rollback_score_alert.yaml.
release_notes: Added staged shadow probing and weighted canary rollouts with proactive multi-metric auto-rollback. Feature is behind feature flag rollout.unified_staged_shadow. See docs/ops/rollouts_autorollback.md for migration and ops runbook.
notes_for_ops: Monitor metric rollout.rollback_score and stage_sample_size. If false positives occur, reduce stage volumes or increase min_sample_size. Use manual override in console to pause ramping.
security_notes: No PII introduced. Manual override gated by rollout:edit permission. All telemetry emitted as aggregated metrics and sanitized traces.
